3210 v6.00 and v5.01 share a 4-row by 5-column scan; physical key edges use MAD2 IRQ0 and decode through the firmware 0x41/0x42/0x43 sequence, while CCONT remains on IRQ6

3210 v6.00 and v5.01 share the live timer-0 divider, coherent 16-bit counter, counter-plus-two compare, FIQ4 assertion and write-one-clear acknowledgement contract; the physical input clock remains unproved

MAD2 SIMI offsets 0x36..0x3f plus FIQ line 6 carry asynchronous T=0 traffic; TXD enters a 16-byte FIFO, control 0x3e value 0x00 flushes it, 0x3f reports fill, and IIR 0x10 advances multi-chunk transmit

MAD2 DSPIF is a retained four-byte peer register; command halfword 0x0004 marks shared-control and L1 DSP work, while independent contact/service timers and the observed ring-producer and service-pending triggers are required because command 4 does not accompany every contact-ring commit
